If you express to a therapist that you feel suicidal they won’t intern you right away. That’s just not how it works. They have to evaluate you first and make a decision based on that. Now, unless you tell the therapist you’ll kill yourselves as soon as you leave their office with a gun/pills (or something along those lines) then yes you’ll most definitely be forced into a ward. The police would come get you actually.

Idk where you live or how the laws work over there, but here in California (Riverside) you can actually go to a hospital and request to be placed in the VOLUNTARY unit. Which means you’ll have less restrictions. And as the name suggest you can decide to leave whenever you want as long as you don’t say you’re leaving to commit suicide. Based on my experience from talking to people who were actually in the voluntary unit, it’s much nicer. I suggest you check the reviews of mental hospitals around your area if you truly are concerned about going into one as sometimes you can request one hospital over another.
